title: Know Your Stock
description:
Every animal carries inherited genetics: **yield, fertility, growth rate and constitution**, plus a personality trait and a generation count.

You can't see any of it by looking. Craft the **Farm Magnifying Glass** and right-click an animal to read its stats.

This is how selective breeding works — check a pair before you breed them, and keep the offspring that came out better than its parents.

*The Farm Ledger gives a fuller report if you want more detail.*
